ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_NONUITFAUMBALANCE_TRU] AS
BEGIN

-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.NonUITFAUMBalance  ( 
[BaseAccountId]
,[CustomerAccountId]
,[BalanceTimestamp]
,[ProductId]
,[OriginalCurrencyABalancemount]
,[BalanceAmount]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
    BASE_NO AS BaseAccountId
    ,PF_NO AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ASOFDATE AS BalanceTimestamp
    ,PRODUCT_CODE AS ProductId
    ,AUM AS OriginalCurrencyABalancemount
    ,AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR AS BalanceAmount
    ,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode 
    ,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId  
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.TRU_AUMNONUITF BTA 
WHERE BTA.isLatest = '1' 

END
GO
